notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
[b]Attention all Football (Bus) Fans, we have just released a major update to the game![/b]

We have added Full Controller Support to the game's Menus in addition to the existing gamepad support.
Many visual updates were made to improve your road experience:
[list]
[*] Get ready to evade 2 new vehicles in your valiant chase!
[*] Checkout the new paint jobs on all the traffic, but don't get too close...
[*] Enjoy crispier graphics due to our updated graphical settings
[/list]
And let's not forget about the added customization options allowing you even more Neon, Colours & Rim options!

Updated collision models on all our vehicles now offer increased accuracy, don't blame it on us if you still get a head on collision though...

Read all the changelog details below!

[h3]Added Vehicles[/h3]
[list]
[*] Limousine
[*] Truck Front without Trailer
[/list]

[h3]Added Vehicle Skins[/h3]
[list]
[*] Coupe +2 skins
[*] Pickup +2 skins
[*] SUV +1 skin
[*] Taxi +1 skin
[*] Truck Front +1 skin
[*] Truck Trailer +1 skin
[/list]

[h3]Added Customization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new variations for Neon
[*] Added 4 new Spoilers through Colour variations
[*] Added a Rim variation
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Full Controller Support to Main Menu & Ingame Menu
[*] Improved Texture Settings/Quality
[*] Increased Render Distance
[*] Tweaked Collisions
[*] Tweaked Colouring on Armor
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Windows & Mac December Update
notes.content:
To improve accessibility we have added a Quit button to the Main Menu for players who only use Mouse input.
Additionally we improved ingame response to opening the Steam Overlay.

[list]
[*]Improved accessibility in Main Menu
[*]Improved Steam Overlay handling
[/list]

notes.title: Windows & Mac November Bugfixes
notes.content:
After debugging we were able to reproduce some issues with loading information and buttons on the Summary Screen that was reported.
We have looked into the underlying issues and applied some fixes, they should now be resolved.

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs related to the Summary Screen
[/list]
